{{Quote|Imperial High Command decided that defender pilots would only be selected from TIE interceptor pilots who had flown at least twenty combat missions and survived. We're either the best pilots in the Imperial fleet or the luckiest.|Rexler Brath|<ref name="NEG" />}}
'''Rexler Brath''' was an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[TIE pilot]] who flew a [[TIE/IN interceptor/Legends|TIE/IN interceptor]] and survived at least twenty [[Starfighter combat/Legends|combat]] missions, being selected to fly a [[TIE/d "Defender" Multi-Role Starfighter/Legends|TIE/D Defender]] as a reward. Shortly before [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY's]] [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]], Brath was assigned to lead the Imperial [[Onyx Squadron/Legends|Onyx Squadron]], and would lead the [[Squadron/Legends|squadron]] during the subsequent battle.

==Biography==
[[File:OnyxSquadronAce-SWZ.png|thumb|right|270px|Onyx Squadron, the TIE/D Defender squadron Brath was selected to lead]]
Rexler Brath, an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[TIE pilot]], flew a [[TIE/IN interceptor/Legends|TIE/IN interceptor]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] fought between the Empire and the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]]. At some point, Brath was one of multiple [[TIE series/Legends|TIE]] [[Interceptor/Legends|interceptor]] [[Pilot/Legends|pilots]] who had flown and survived at least twenty [[Starfighter combat/Legends|combat]] missions and were selected to fly [[TIE/d "Defender" Multi-Role Starfighter/Legends|TIE/D Defenders]]. Shortly before<ref name="NEG" /> [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY's]]<ref name="NEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' dates the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]] to [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]].</ref> [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]], Rexler Brath, while serving as a TIE/D Defender pilot, was assigned to lead [[Onyx Squadron/Legends|Onyx Squadron]].<ref name="NEG" /> At one point, Brath, [[Laser/Legends|firing]] his<ref name="Envelope" /> TIE/D Defender's [[Laser cannon/Legends|laser cannons]], flew in front of a [[Starship/Legends|starship]].<ref name="FFG">{{FFGXW2|set=Galactic Empire Conversion Kit|cardname=Rexler Brath}} {{C|Reissued in ''[[TIE/D Defender Expansion Pack]]''}}</ref> Brath ultimately led Onyx Squadron during the Battle of [[Endor/Legends|Endor]],<ref name="CSWE">{{CSWECite|II|414|Onyx Squadron}}</ref> which led to an Imperial defeat by the Alliance to Restore the Republic.<ref name="RotJ">{{Film|VI}}</ref>

==Personality and traits==
At some point, Brath recounted the selection process for the TIE/D Defender pilots, and as part of that group, he individually considered all of them to either be the [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy's]] best or luckiest pilots after they each survived at least twenty combat missions.<ref name="NEG" />

==Behind the scenes==
Rexler Brath was created by [[2003]]'s ''[[The New Essential Guide to Vehicles and Vessels]]''.<ref name="NEG" /> In [[2014]], he was first visually depicted, flying a TIE/D Defender, in the ''[[TIE Defender Expansion Pack]]'' of the ''[[Star Wars: X-Wing Miniatures Game]]''.<ref name="FFG2">{{FFGXW|set=TIE Defender Expansion Pack|cardname=Rexler Brath}}</ref>
